name: week
title: This week in the price book
subtitle: Cost moves, margins under the floor, specials ending and notices to send

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select what,item,detail from (select 1 as o,'cost moved, price not reviewed' as what,sku as item,currency||' cost '||round(previous_cost_cents/100.0,2)||' to '||round(cost_cents/100.0,2) as detail from cost_moves where price_set_on is null or price_set_on<cost_from union all select 2,'special expiring',customer||' '||sku,'ends '||valid_to from special_work where status='approved' and days_left between 0 and (select value from policy where key='special_expiry_warning_days') union all select 3,'notice to send',customer,notice_state||', notify by '||notify_by from notice_work where notice_state<>'notified') a order by o,item

sections.title: Below the margin floor
sections.note: Margin is price less today's cost, as a share of price, in the list's own currency.
sections.sql: select list,sku,min_qty,currency,price_cents,cost_cents,margin_bps,floor_bps from list_margins where margin_bps<floor_bps order by margin_bps

sections.title: Price change notices
sections.sql: select change,effective_on,customer,rep,notice_days,notify_by,notified_on,notice_state from notice_work order by notify_by,customer

name: leakage
title: Price leakage
subtitle: Invoiced below the price each customer is entitled to, over the policy window

sections.title: By rep
sections.sql: select rep,currency,count(*)::int as lines,sum(leakage_cents)::bigint as leakage_cents from leakage where leakage_cents>0 group by rep,currency order by 4 desc

sections.title: By customer and product
sections.sql: select customer,sku,currency,basis,qty,entitled_cents,realised_cents,leakage_cents from leakage where leakage_cents>0 order by leakage_cents desc

sections.title: Every live price
sections.sql: select list,sku,name,min_qty,currency,price_cents,cost_cents,margin_bps,floor_bps,target_bps from list_margins order by list,sku,min_qty

sections.title: Customer specials
sections.sql: select customer,sku,currency,price_cents,list_price_cents,margin_bps,valid_to,status,approved_by from special_work order by valid_to
